description: Line-addressed inventory of every legacy Convex hook/action/provider call site across the approved RN source roots (app/, components/, hooks/, screens/). Produced by `holo inventory:convex-callsites`.

counting_rule.summary: file_count = files containing any lexical mention of a legacy Convex hook name. call_sites = real invocations of useQuery/useMutation/useAction plus ConvexProvider JSX and new ConvexReactClient constructor.

file_count.counted: Any .ts/.tsx file under an approved source root whose source contains a regex match for \b(useQuery|useMutation|useAction|useConvex|ConvexProvider|ConvexReactClient)\b. The mention may appear in an import, comment, type annotation, or real call — all of these signal participation in the legacy Convex migration surface.
file_count.includes_test_files: Test files (*.test.ts, *.test.tsx, *.spec.ts, *.spec.tsx) are counted in file_count because they import/mock legacy hooks and must be migrated alongside production code.

not_counted: useConvex(...) — PRD §07-ui-infrastructure.md defines the 105-site contract as useQuery (~48) + useMutation/useAction (~57). The useConvex client handle is captured indirectly: its host file is counted in file_count and its sibling useAction/useMutation sites are recorded. The useConvex handle itself is a network client accessor that S-CONTRACT-02 will map to the Zero mutator surface.
import statements (e.g., `import { useQuery } from 'convex/react'`) — no `(` directly follows the identifier
line comments (//) and block comments (/* */) — stripped before scanning

record_fields.call_site_id: First 16 hex chars of SHA-256(source_path + ':' + line + ':' + column + ':' + hook_kind) — stable across reruns.
record_fields.source_path: Repo-relative POSIX path (forward slashes) within an approved source root.
record_fields.line: 1-indexed line number where the hook identifier or JSX tag starts.
record_fields.hook_kind: One of: useQuery | useMutation | useAction | ConvexProvider | ConvexReactClient.
record_fields.legacy_ref: For useQuery/useMutation/useAction: the dotted `api.*` reference (or first-arg expression). For ConvexProvider/ConvexReactClient: the literal kind name.

production_files_with_mentions_only_path: app/(drawer)/chat/reference.tsx — imports `useQuery as useZeroQuery` from @rocicorp/zero/react (migrated surface)

observed_counts.note: Observed counts match the PRD's 47-file / 105-call-site contract under the documented counting rule.

determinism.sort_order: call_sites are sorted by (source_path ASC, line ASC, column ASC, hook_kind ASC)
determinism.id_rule: SHA-256 of `source_path:line:column:hook_kind`, truncated to 16 hex chars
determinism.rerun_sha256: Two consecutive runs against the same checkout produce byte-identical artifacts (verified by shasum -a 256).
